title: Binary/hex -1 is parsed into 9223372036854775808
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: v4.5.stable.official [876b29033], v4.0.4.stable.official [fc0b241c9] ### System information Godot v4.5.stable - Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS 24.04 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) UHD Graphics 620 (WHL GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-8565U CPU @ 1.80GHz (8 threads) - 23.32 GiB memory ### Issue description Binary/hex -1 is parsed into 9223372036854775808. Also, debugger tab shows these errors: E 0:00:00:989 warnings_manager.gd:159 @ load_script_using_custom_warnings(): Cannot represent 0b1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111 as a 64-bit signed integer, since the value is too large. Condition "overflow" is true. Returning: sign == 1 ? (9223372036854775807L) : (-9223372036854775807L-1) core/string/ustring.cpp:2265 @ bin_to_int() warnings_manager.gd:159 @ load_script_using_custom_warnings() test_collector.gd:76 @ _parse_script() test_collector.gd:127 @ add_script() gut.gd:1050 @ add_script() gut.gd:1073 @ add_directory() gut_config.gd:136 @ _apply_options() gut_config.gd:207 @ apply_options() GutRunner.gd:191 @ run_tests() E 0:00:01:821 warnings_manager.gd:159 @ load_script_using_custom_warnings(): Cannot represent 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF as a 64-bit signed integer, since the value is too large. Condition "overflow" is true. Returning: sign == 1 ? (9223372036854775807L) : (-9223372036854775807L-1) core/string/ustring.cpp:2226 @ hex_to_int() warnings_manager.gd:159 @ load_script_using_custom_warnings() test_collector.gd:76 @ _parse_script() test_collector.gd:127 @ add_script() gut.gd:1050 @ add_script() gut.gd:1073 @ add_directory() gut_config.gd:136 @ _apply_options() gut_config.gd:207 @ apply_options() GutRunner.gd:191 @ run_tests() ### Steps to reproduce ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [New Game Project.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25395470/New.Game.Project.zip)
